title: The 1 Quranic Habit That Made Muhammad Ali A Champion Before Age 25 🏆
script: Muhammad Ali was knocked down three times before he became the youngest heavyweight champion. He failed. Again. But then, something incredible happened - he discovered the power of patience and perseverance, a key lesson from the Quran. This one habit, mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Asr, is why ninety percent of people stay unsuccessful. What if you could apply this same habit to your daily life? Would you be able to overcome any obstacle? The answer lies in a simple yet powerful verse. It's about trusting in a higher power and having faith that everything will work out for the best. So, what's the one habit that made Muhammad Ali a champion? It's patience and perseverance, a lesson that can be applied to any area of your life. Remember, with patience and perseverance, you can achieve anything you set your mind to.
